clips.title: The story
paras: Across Mulgore, swoops soar as predatory birds, and their gizzards go into traditional remedies for deadly toxins.

Swoops hunt across Mulgore’s plains and mesas, with keen eyes and a taste for scavenging. Tauren use their feathers and meat in daily life, while herbalists and healers prize their internal organs, especially the gizzard. Dense and muscular, it helps counter venomous bites and festering infections when combined with cougar bones and wolf hearts.

In Bloodhoof Village, Maur Raincaller tends the wound Mazzranache left on his shoulder. The legendary plainstrider’s venom drives Maur into delirium as the poison creeps through him. To make a poultice that can expel the lethal venom, Maur needs a swoop gizzard, a prairie wolf heart, a flatland cougar femur, and a plainstrider scale.
